# Doodz

> Doodz is an Android app that automatically draws any image as a doodle on Instagram. Standard mode makes a fast single-colour doodle; Hyper Doodle builds a detailed multicolour doodle using Instagram's colour palettes. It needs only the Accessibility permission and processes images on-device. Not affiliated with Instagram or Meta.

Key facts:
- Platform: Android (iPhone not supported yet). Distribution: direct APK from https://doodz-rust.vercel.app/Doodz.apk
- Modes: Standard (upload image, select area, select brush, tap Start) and Hyper Doodle (select area, calibrate with 2 dots, tap Start)
- Privacy: images and screenshots are processed on the device
- Contact: junaidpasha9986@gmail.com, WhatsApp +917892689778
- Maker: ForVano (https://forvano.com)
